scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @pit/model && node --env-file-if-exists=.env deployment/prepare-local.mjs && node deployment/dev.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pit/model && npm run build --workspace @pit/controller && npm run build --workspace @pit/view
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @pit/model && npm run typecheck --workspace @pit/model && npm run typecheck --workspace @pit/controller && npm run typecheck --workspace @pit/view
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @pit/model && npm run test --workspace @pit/model && npm run test --workspace @pit/controller && npm run test --workspace @pit/view && node --test tests/local-setup.test.mjs tests/product-images.test.mjs
